pages.text:
File 2
Listening 1
1
Reception
Hello, reception.
Lisa
Oh hello. I’m in room 214. Is my bag there?
Reception
Er … is it a green bag?
Lisa
No, it isn’t. It’s blue.
Reception
OK … Blue? Blue? I have two blue bags here. What’s
in the bag?
Lisa
In it? Er … OK. Keys. No. My keys are here. They’re in
my coat. They aren’t in the bag. Er … my mobile
phone. Yes. That’s in the bag. And my ID card. Yes.
That’s in the bag.
Reception
OK. Mobile phone. An ID card. Er … Are your glasses
in the bag?
Lisa
Er … Yes, they are.
Reception
And a small dictionary?
Lisa
Oh, yes. My Spanish dictionary. Yes.
Reception
And your credit card?
Lisa
Er … No. My credit card isn’t in the bag, but my
boyfriend’s credit card is. Yes. I have his credit card
and it’s in my bag! Oh no.
Reception
It’s OK. This is your bag here. It’s blue, and, yes, a
mobile phone, your ID card, your glasses, a small
dictionary, and a credit card with the name Peter
Morgan … is your boyfriend’s name Peter Morgan?
Lisa
Yes, it is.
Reception
OK. This is your bag.
Lisa
Good. I'll come and …
File 2
Listening 2
1
John
Hi Anna.
Anna
Hi. Oh, John, this is Adam. Adam, this is John.
Adam
Hi John.
John
Hello Adam. Are you Anna’s boyfriend?
Anna
No, he isn’t. He’s my brother. My boyfriend’s name is
Dan.
John
Dan?
Anna
Yes.
John
Oh. Sorry.
2
Andy
Look. I have a photo in my bag. Here it is.
Gemma
Oooh, Andy. Is this your family?
Andy
Yes. This is Sam. He’s my son. And that’s my wife Jill.
And she’s Katy – my daughter. She’s two.
Gemma
It’s a nice photo.
Andy
Thanks.
3
Jack
Wow! Is that a new mobile phone?
Felicity
Yes, it is. Fantastic, isn’t it? It’s small but it’s very good.
And it isn’t expensive.
Jack
Really? Wow. What’s your new number?
4
Sally
Hi Graeme. How are you?
Graeme
I’m fine thanks, Sally. And you?
Sally
Fine. This is my sister Emma. Emma, this is Graeme, a
friend from work.
Graeme
Hi Emma.
Emma
Hi Graeme.
5
Karen
He’s good-looking.
Helen
Who?
Karen
Him. The tall man – over there.
Helen
Oh, Mark. Yes, he is.
Karen
How old is he?
Helen
Mark?
Karen
Yes.
Helen
Oh, er … 26 or 27?
Karen
26 or 27?
Helen
Er … 27 … yes. He’s 27. And very tall.
